messages.text:
I can’t refund all three today: our records show two napkins received back, but not the third. Items must be received before they can be refunded. (refund-policy/v2/return)

The discounted amount paid was **BRL 91.00 per napkin**. For identical items, the discounted total is divided equally, rounded down to the nearest cent; any leftover cents are added one at a time to the last items. Those shares stay fixed. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Would you like to request **BRL 182.00 for the two received napkins**? Also, have you already sent the third? Payment today isn’t guaranteed: confirmation and staff approval are required first. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
